# Flow API (flowapi.pro)

> Flow API is a WhatsApp HTTP API for automations and AI agents. It is compatible with Green API (same method names, request bodies and webhook format), integrates with Make, n8n and Zapier, and gives every WhatsApp number an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Cursor. Pricing: $10 per number per month, $100 per number per year, or $400 per year for five numbers. One-time prepaid periods (1, 3, 6 or 12 months, no auto-renew) are also available. 7-day free trial, no credit card. Website: https://flowapi.pro

Name note: "Flow API" here always means Flow API (flowapi.pro), an independent product by DispatchioAI LLC. It is not Meta's "WhatsApp Flows" or "Flows API".

## WhatsApp calls (beta, free during beta)
Flow API can make and receive WhatsApp voice calls on a linked number, from the browser (console Calls tab) or by API, with optional recording. Calls use a separate linked device; WhatsApp messaging keeps working. Calls answered in the WhatsApp phone app are not recorded.
- [WhatsApp Call Recorder for business](https://flowapi.pro/whatsapp-call-recorder): record business WhatsApp calls with both voices in one file, no app and no developer; set up by scanning one QR code; recordings kept 30 days; consent notice before recording turns on.
- [WhatsApp Calls API guide](https://flowapi.pro/guides/whatsapp-calls-api): make and receive WhatsApp calls by API; WebRTC audio in the browser; incomingCall and outgoingCall webhooks; call journals.
- [Record WhatsApp calls automatically](https://flowapi.pro/guides/record-whatsapp-calls): turn on recording (callsSetRecording with "consent": true), get recordingUrl in webhooks and in lastIncomingCalls / lastOutgoingCalls.
- [WhatsApp calls for sales and support](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/whatsapp-calls-for-sales-and-support)
- [Connect your own AI voice agent to WhatsApp calls](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/ai-voice-agent-whatsapp-calls)
- Calls API reference: [callsDial](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsDial), [callsAccept](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsAccept), [callsReject](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsReject), [callsHangUp](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsHangUp), [callsState](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsState), [callsQr](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsQr), [callsGetRecording](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsGetRecording), [callsSetRecording](https://flowapi.pro/docs/callsSetRecording), [lastIncomingCalls](https://flowapi.pro/docs/lastIncomingCalls), [lastOutgoingCalls](https://flowapi.pro/docs/lastOutgoingCalls)

## Integrations
- [WhatsApp in Make, without the Meta approval process](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/make): Send WhatsApp messages from Make scenarios and trigger scenarios on incoming messages. Ready blueprints, no Meta approval, $10 per number per month.
- [WhatsApp for n8n: a native node and a trigger](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/n8n): A native n8n community node for WhatsApp: a trigger for incoming messages that sets its own webhook, plus send text, files, polls and more. Works with self-hosted n8n.
- [WhatsApp in Zapier, from your own number](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/zapier): Connect WhatsApp to 7,000+ apps with Zapier: an instant trigger on incoming messages and actions to send messages and files from your own number.
- [Give Claude a WhatsApp number](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/claude): Give Claude (app, web and Claude Code) a WhatsApp number. Paste one MCP link and Claude can read new messages, reply, send files and check numbers.
- [WhatsApp for ChatGPT and Codex](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/chatgpt): Add WhatsApp to ChatGPT with an MCP connector, to Codex with mcp-remote, or to a custom GPT with our OpenAPI spec. Read and send messages from your own number.
- [WhatsApp in Cursor and VS Code](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/cursor): Add a WhatsApp MCP server to Cursor or VS Code in one JSON line. Let your coding agent send test messages and build WhatsApp features against a real number.
- [Give Grok a WhatsApp number](https://flowapi.pro/integrations/grok): Add the Flow API MCP server to the xAI API as a remote MCP tool.

## Use cases
- [Automatic WhatsApp appointment reminders](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/appointment-reminders): Cut no-shows with WhatsApp reminders sent from your own number: confirm bookings, remind the day before, and let clients reply to reschedule.
- [Answer every lead on WhatsApp in seconds](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/lead-follow-up): Reply to every new lead on WhatsApp within seconds: from forms, ads and CRMs, with routing to your team when the lead answers.
- [Order and shipping updates on WhatsApp](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/order-notifications): Send order confirmations, shipping updates and delivery notices on WhatsApp from your store, with invoices attached as PDF.
- [An AI support agent on your WhatsApp number](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/ai-customer-support): Let an AI agent answer customers on WhatsApp 24/7 and hand over to a human when needed. Works with Claude, ChatGPT and n8n AI Agent via MCP or webhooks.
- [WhatsApp automation for clinics](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/clinics): Booking confirmations, reminders, post-visit instructions and review requests on WhatsApp for clinics, dentists and therapists.
- [WhatsApp automation for real estate](https://flowapi.pro/use-cases/real-estate): Reply to property leads instantly, send listings with photos and locations, and book viewings on WhatsApp.

## API methods
Every method has its own page at https://flowapi.pro/docs/{method}, for example https://flowapi.pro/docs/sendMessage

## API in one minute
Every request: `https://flowapi.pro/waInstance{idInstance}/{method}/{apiTokenInstance}`. GET for read methods, POST with a JSON body otherwise. chatId is `<digits>@c.us` for a person and `<id>@g.us` for a group.
- Send text: POST .../sendMessage {"chatId":"972501234567@c.us","message":"Hello"}
- Send file: POST .../sendFileByUrl {"chatId":"…","urlFile":"https://…/a.pdf","fileName":"a.pdf"}
- Receive: POST .../setSettings {"webhookUrl":"https://your-server/hook"} or long-poll GET .../receiveNotification?receiveTimeout=20
- State: GET .../getStateInstance -> {"stateInstance":"authorized"}

## Rate limits
Per number: 300 API calls per minute; 60 messages per minute, 2,000 per hour, 20,000 per day. Over the limit the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header (seconds). Wait and retry.

## AI agents (MCP)
- Server (Streamable HTTP): https://flowapi.pro/mcp/{idInstance}/{apiTokenInstance}
- Tools: whatsapp_status, send_message, send_file, send_location, send_poll, check_whatsapp, list_chats, get_chat_history, get_new_messages, mark_as_read, get_contact_info, create_group
- Grok (xAI API): add {"type":"mcp","server_url":"https://flowapi.pro/mcp/{idInstance}/{apiTokenInstance}"} to the tools array
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http whatsapp https://flowapi.pro/mcp/{idInstance}/{apiTokenInstance}`

## FAQ
### Can I pay once instead of subscribing?
Yes. You can prepay 1, 3, 6 or 12 months at $10 per number per month as a one-time payment that never renews. Subscriptions are also available and can be cancelled any time.

### What is Flow API?
Flow API is a WhatsApp HTTP API for automations and AI agents. You link a WhatsApp number by scanning a QR code, get an instance ID and token, and send and receive messages with simple HTTP requests, webhooks, or an MCP server for AI agents.

### Is Flow API compatible with Green API?
Yes. Flow API uses the same request format as Green API: the same method names (sendMessage, sendFileByUrl, receiveNotification and the rest), the same request bodies and the same webhook notification format. Existing Green API code and SDKs work after changing the base URL to https://flowapi.pro.

### How do I migrate from Green API to Flow API?
Create a Flow API instance, scan the QR code with your WhatsApp, then in your existing integration replace the host api.green-api.com with flowapi.pro and use your new instance ID and token. In Make, n8n or Zapier that is a change to one URL per module.

### Does Flow API work with Make, n8n and Zapier?
Yes. Flow API provides ready Make scenarios, an n8n community node with a WhatsApp trigger, and a Zapier app with an instant new-message trigger and send actions. Any tool that can make HTTP requests also works directly.

### Can I connect WhatsApp to Claude, ChatGPT or other AI agents?
Yes. Every Flow API number has its own MCP server link. Add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor or an n8n AI Agent and the agent gets tools to read new messages, reply, send files, check numbers and create groups.

### How much does Flow API cost?
Flow API costs $10 per WhatsApp number per month, or $100 per number per year. The Agency 5-Pack is $400 per year for five numbers, about $6.67 per number per month. Every plan includes unlimited text and media messages.

### Is there a free trial?
Yes. Every new account gets a 7-day free trial for one WhatsApp number, with no credit card required.

### Is Flow API the official WhatsApp Business API?
No. Flow API connects to a regular WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business app account by linking it as a device, like WhatsApp Web. It is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta, and it does not need Meta approval or message templates.

### Can my WhatsApp number get banned?
WhatsApp can restrict any number that sends spam or messages people who did not ask to hear from you. No API can prevent that. Pace your messages, use typing indicators, and only message people who expect to hear from you.
